rubric.accept: The line's own verbatim text plus local context fix a specific pupil deviation AND a specific correction, with no dictated source needed. Includes: (a) non-word mangled spellings with a unique real repair; (b) agreement/case/word-form violations fixed by the line's own syntax; (c) word-internal hyphenation where the transcript records word-internal hyphens verbatim (p17-l09 writes 'кого-или' beside 'чего либо'); (d) composites kept as one record when at least one component is established by the line text - unestablished components are named in the reason and in expected_adjudicated.
rubric.undecided: A live candidate that text alone cannot settle: an omitted or present PUNCTUATION MARK (policy.json visual_rule requires the pixels; a comma is easy to lose in transcription), a non-word whose repair is not unique, or a span the transcriber's own uncertain[] note flags as garbled or recorded letter by letter. Deferred to pixels/source, not recorded.
rubric.reject: Not a recordable pupil error, by class: line-wrap artefacts (line-opening colon, line-end cut fragments), dash-spacing notation, doubled/mixed terminal marks ('?.', ':.', '.,', '.?'), headings and topic labels (label morphology is not adjudicable), table/cell boundaries read as missing sentences, dotted or truncated abbreviations and scheme labels, self-contradicted clipped fragments, duplicates of another record.
rubric.error_class: policy.json broad_error_class: letters (the writing itself is not a word / letter-level deviation; the product's current target, deferred=false), meaning (agreement, case, word form, missing word, sentence-level; deferred=true per LABELLING-POLICY section 1), punctuation (marks and hyphenation; deferred=true).
rubric.accepted_confidence: high where the transcriber's own note names the intended word (e.g. p17-l22 'the pupil's own form for запятых') or Astra's by-eye sample3 adjudicates the key; medium where the line's syntax or a fixed term fixes the correction. No ACCEPT is published at low confidence.
